gloss_en: How do IFC file revisions get managed on the Catenda Models page?
question_paraphrase: how do I manage IFC revisions in Catenda models page
answer_summary: Catenda describes Models as containers for revisions of IFC files; the Models page is where revisions are uploaded and viewed.

gloss_en: How to see object information and properties in the Catenda viewer?
question_paraphrase: where do I see IFC object properties in the viewer
answer_summary: Catenda separates 2D and 3D viewers (14 articles) from an Information Panel collection covering object properties.

gloss_en: Where can users ask Trimble Connect questions (user forum, knowledge center)?
question_paraphrase: trimble connect user forum for questions about models
phrasing_notes: community landing page only; no IFC thread opened
answer_summary: Trimble hosts a Trimble Connect User Forum (about 7.6K threads) and Knowledge Center; newer discussions moved to networkcommunity.trimble.com.

gloss_en: Why will this IFC not show in ACC viewer
prompt: uploaded this ifc to ACC and it just says processing failed. can you see whats wrong with the file
expected_behavior: Open the IFC, check schema header, size, element and geometry counts, invalid or empty geometry, unsupported entities; list likely causes and fixes.

gloss_en: Properties show elsewhere but not in Trimble Connect; check psets exist
prompt: props not showing in trimble connect for walls, are the psets even in the ifc?
expected_behavior: List property sets on IfcWall, report whether Pset_WallCommon etc. exist with values, note empty or quantity-only sets.

gloss_en: Compare the new revision with the previous one
prompt: compare rev B to rev A, what got added deleted or changed? need it for the issue list
expected_behavior: Match elements by GlobalId, report added/removed/modified with property and geometry differences grouped by class.

gloss_en: Check whether GUIDs are stable between exports
prompt: every export the guids are different, dalux is losing our issues. check if guids match with last version
expected_behavior: Compare GlobalIds between two files, report percent preserved, suggest export setting for stable IDs.

gloss_en: List storeys and element counts per storey
prompt: list storeys w/ how many elements each, bimcollab shows only one level
expected_behavior: Traverse IfcBuildingStorey containment, count elements per storey, flag elements not contained in any storey.

gloss_en: Models from two disciplines far apart after federating
prompt: federated arch and mep in ACC, mep is 40km away. which ifc has the wrong coordinates
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite, IfcMapConversion, placements and bounding boxes of both files, identify the offset, propose fix.

gloss_en: Why is the IFC 900MB
prompt: ifc is 900mb and trimble connect chokes. what is taking all the space
expected_behavior: Report entity type distribution by size, find heavy items, suggest reductions.

gloss_en: Fix proxies before uploading to CDE
prompt: lots of IfcBuildingElementProxy in this one, remap them to proper classes by name before I upload
expected_behavior: Identify proxies, infer classes from names/types, propose mapping, apply on a copy and report.

gloss_en: Which IFC schema should I upload to the CDE
prompt: does the cde support ifc4 or should I stay with 2x3? model looks ok in one viewer only
expected_behavior: Explain schema support differences, recommend testing with a small export, check viewer support.

gloss_en: Find elements with no geometry
prompt: which objects in the ifc have no geometry? they show as invisible in viewer
expected_behavior: List elements without Representation, group by class, note spaces and annotation exceptions.

gloss_en: Revit shared parameters missing in IFC viewed in the CDE
prompt: shared params from revit not in ifc on the cde. export setting?
expected_behavior: Explain exporting user-defined property sets, mapping file, IFC export options and verification.

gloss_en: Get wall area totals by type
prompt: total wall net area by wall type from this ifc
expected_behavior: Read Qto_WallBaseQuantities or compute geometry, sum by IfcWallType, show table and source.

gloss_en: Check model against requirements before upload
prompt: before I push this to the cde, can you check every door has FireRating and a classification
expected_behavior: Check IfcDoor for FireRating and classification references, list failures with GlobalId and name.

gloss_en: Model appears all grey in viewer
prompt: all grey in dalux, colors gone. does ifc have styles?
expected_behavior: Check IfcStyledItem and presentation styles on representations, report missing, explain export option.

gloss_en: Find elements not in the spatial structure
prompt: anything floating outside the building structure in this ifc?
expected_behavior: Find elements lacking containment or aggregation, list by class.

gloss_en: Why is version 2 much smaller
prompt: v2 is half the size of v1 but same project, whats missing
expected_behavior: Compare entity counts per class between both files and report what disappeared.

gloss_en: How BCF issues map to GUIDs after new IFC revision
prompt: how do bcf issues map to guids after i upload a new ifc revision
expected_behavior: Explain BCF viewpoint component GUID references and what happens when GlobalIds change.
